text:
lena: Quick sync — we need a short, unambiguous taxonomy for 'pin grace' windows before forced migration. Customers keep asking for clarity when pins expire and what rollback options exist.

omar: +1. Proposal: three tiers — soft-grace (7d), standard-grace (30d), extended-grace (custom contract). soft=auto-swap to closest compatible model, standard=notify + 7d hold, extended=manual ops only. Thoughts?

sanjay: Like tiering. Need to define 'compatible' clearly — same family + max delta tokens? Also how we surface costs to the customer during grace.

claire: Add a "critical-customer" flag that bypasses auto-swap (requires legal/Sales signoff). Also require an explicit rollback playbook per customer pinned >60d.

omar: Draft of rollback playbook (high level):
1) Detect anomaly in quality/regressions
2) Pause auto-switch and notify customer
3) Offer immediate rollback to previous pinned version for 24h window
4) If rollback fails, spin up fallback node with older model variant

sanjay: Can we codify as a config snippet? e.g.
```
pin_grace:
  tiers:
    - name: soft
      duration_days: 7
      action: auto_swap
    - name: standard
      duration_days: 30
      action: notify_hold
    - name: extended
      duration_days: 90
      action: manual_ops
```

lena: Nice. Two operational questions: who approves extended pins, and how do we bill during hold (old model vs new)?

claire: Approvers = Sales+Legal+Product. Billing = default to model in use (if customer stays on old model we keep old pricing; if we force a temporary fallback we bill fallback rates and credit if we mis-swapped).

omar: Need SLO language: during grace tiers we guarantee latency/uptime of pinned model only if served on Dedicated/Private. Hosted customers get best-effort and can be charged for custom shims.

sanjay: Also add guardrail: no extended pin for models older than 2 major versions unless explicit risk review.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy 2026-03-22T09:12:00Z started for pinning-service v1.3 — monitors: pin-expiry, rollback-trigger

lena: Action items:
- omar: draft formal taxonomy doc + example YAML by EOD Fri
- sanjay: short list of compatibility rules and token-delta metric
- claire: escalate extended-pin approver flow with Legal/Sales
I'll collect and draft comms for Sales/CS.

omar: will do. adding a tiny UX ask — explicit "grace window" display in Console with countdown + one-click request for extension.

claire: good. :thumbsup:

lena: thanks all — we'll review Friday.
